summary: Milestone 2026.05.124 operational retrospective complete. Analyzed 449 min wall time / 99 experiments (avg ~4.5 min). Slowest paths: Exp 1603 (88 min), Exp 1591 (48 min), Exp 1606 (15 min), Exp 1609 (14 min), and Full-Scale Pipeline v3 gate (14 min). Both RTX 3090s were completely idle at 4 MB / 0% utilization throughout, meaning DualGPURunner was not utilized and parallelization was missed. Estimated 40% savings recoverable via DualGPURunner parallelization and addressing Exp 1603/1591 bottlenecks.
slowest_experiments: Exp 1603: Energy-Based Constraint Network (EBCN) coherence sco (88 min)
Exp 1591: Upgrade DCCD smoke to reusable structured verdict ad (48 min)
Exp 1606: DCCD repair on multi-hop reasoning tasks (15 min)
Full-Scale Pipeline v3 — Gated on Exp 1414 Repair Executor (14 min)
bottlenecks_identified: Exp 1603 and Exp 1591 consumed disproportionate amounts of wall time.
Both RTX 3090 GPUs were completely idle, missing parallelization opportunities.
Full-Scale Pipeline v3 gate churn persists.
improvements_suggested: Utilize DualGPURunner to run experiments in parallel.
Address the Exp 1603 and 1591 execution paths directly.
Terminalize Full-Scale Pipeline v3 gate blocks early.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Terminalize Full-Scale Pipeline v3 gate blocks.
meta_reflection: Retrospective highlights repeated missing of DualGPU parallelization.
